regulation_clause.text: For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 5(iv)(b) requires strictly_greater 10 percent of capital or profits. WS-BO-THRESHOLD is declared VALUE 10.00 (line 18) and 2000-IDENTIFY-BO flags BO when capital or profit percentage strictly exceeds 10 (lines 31-32), matching the clause exactly. The additional WS-CONTROL-IND disjunct (line 33) is a superset check that does not contradict the cited obligation.

provenance.annotator_notes: Human primary annotation and Claude verification agreed on this classification without final review.
